name: Cli A2A

name: Cli Backup Sync
summary: Backup and restore OmniRoute data from the CLI. Trigger incremental snapshots, sync to cloud storage, manage backup schedules, and restore from archive files.

name: Cli Batches
summary: Submit and monitor batch inference jobs from the CLI. Upload and manage files for batch processing, retrieve results, and integrate batch pipelines with CI/CD workflows.

name: Cli Chat
summary: Send chat completions, stream responses, and start an interactive REPL session from the CLI. Supports all OmniRoute providers, combo routing, and system prompt configuration.

name: Cli Compression
summary: Configure and test prompt compression from the CLI. Manage RTK filters, Caveman rules, stacked compression modes, and preview compression output with real prompts.

name: Cli Contexts
summary: Manage context engineering configurations, RTK filter sets, and conversation sessions from the CLI. Apply context-relay settings and inspect active context pipelines.

name: Cli Cost Usage
summary: View cost breakdowns, token usage, and call logs from the CLI. Filter by provider, model, or date range. Export usage reports and inspect per-connection spending.

name: Cli Eval
summary: Create and run evaluation suites, watch live benchmark progress, view scorecards, compare model performance, and integrate eval runs with CI workflows from the CLI.

name: Cli Health
summary: Check server health, component status, and live metrics from the CLI. Run `health`, `health components`, and `health watch` for a real-time dashboard of circuit breakers and provider status.

name: Cli Keys
summary: Create, list, rotate, and revoke OmniRoute API keys from the CLI. Manage OAuth flows for provider authentication and inspect key scopes and expiration.

name: Cli Mcp
summary: Inspect the MCP server status, list registered tools and scopes, run tool invocations, and manage MCP audit logs from the CLI.

name: Cli Models
summary: Query available AI models, list model aliases, and browse the full model catalog from the CLI. Filter by provider, search by capability, and resolve model name variants.

name: Cli Plugins Skills
summary: Manage Omni Skills (list, install, test, remove), plugins (create, configure), and persistent memory (search, add, clear) from the CLI.

name: Cli Policy Audit
summary: Inspect audit logs, manage access policies, view telemetry data, and review request history from the CLI. Filter by event type, user, or time range for compliance workflows.

name: Cli Providers
summary: Manage provider connections from the CLI: list available/configured providers, add, test, test-all, validate, rotate API keys, and view per-provider metrics.

name: Cli Resilience
summary: Inspect and manage circuit-breaker states, connection cooldowns, quota limits, and backoff levels from the CLI. Reset stuck providers and configure resilience thresholds.

name: Cli Routing
summary: Create, list, update, and delete routing combos from the CLI. Test routing strategies, inspect combo metrics, and configure fallback chains interactively.

name: Cli Serve
summary: Start, stop, and restart the OmniRoute server from the CLI. Manage daemon mode, port configuration, auto-recovery, system tray integration, and the dashboard open shortcut.

name: Cli Setup
summary: Run initial setup, configure global CLI settings, manage environment variables, check for updates, and configure autostart via the CLI setup and config commands.

name: Cli Skill Collector
summary: Detect installed CLI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Cline and more), search GitHub for matching agent skills, and install them to the detected tools via OmniRoute's built-in APIs.

name: Cli Tunnel
summary: Start and stop tunnel connections (ngrok, Cloudflare, custom) from the CLI. Inspect active tunnel URLs, configure authentication, and test external reachability.

name: Config Codex Cli
summary: Step-by-step agent workflow to configure the OpenAI Codex CLI on any machine (Linux, macOS, Windows) to use OmniRoute as an OpenAI-compatible backend. Detects OS and shell, writes config.toml and 7 named profiles, sets environment variables, and verifies the setup.

name: Omni Agents A2A
summary: Interact with OmniRoute via JSON-RPC 2.0 agent-to-agent protocol. 6 built-in A2A skills: smart-routing, quota-management, provider-discovery, cost-analysis, health-report, list-capabilities.

name: Omni Api Keys
summary: Create, list, rotate, and revoke OmniRoute API keys. Control per-key scopes, spending limits, and expiration. Keys gate access to all proxy and management endpoints.

name: Omni Auth
summary: Manage API key authentication and session tokens. Start here to authenticate requests via Bearer token, obtain session cookies, and configure login requirements for the OmniRoute API.

name: Omni Budget
summary: Configure spending limits, token quotas, and rate-limit policies per API key or globally. Inspect current consumption and enforce cost controls across providers.

name: Omni Cache
summary: Manage the LLM response cache. View cache statistics, clear entries, configure TTL policies, and control semantic-similarity caching thresholds.

name: Omni Cli Tools
summary: Manage CLI tool integrations exposed via the API. List, configure, and invoke CLI tool plugins that extend OmniRoute's automation surface.

name: Omni Combos Routing
summary: Create and manage routing combos with 19 strategies (priority, weighted, round-robin, Auto-combo, and more). Configure fallback chains, test routing outcomes, and retrieve combo metrics.

name: Omni Compression
summary: Configure RTK (command output), Caveman (prose), and stacked compression modes. Manage language packs, custom rules, and test prompt compression reducing tokens by 60–90%.

name: Omni Context Rtk
summary: Configure RTK filters, context engineering rules, and context relay settings. Test compression with real prompt samples and manage context transformation pipelines.

name: Omni Db Backups
summary: Trigger system backups, restore from backup files, and manage the SQLite database lifecycle. Supports export, import, and incremental snapshot strategies.

name: Omni Github Skills
summary: Search, score, scan, and import agent skills from GitHub repositories that contain SKILL.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, and similar agent skill files. Discover community skills across many tool and provider categories, evaluate relevance with heuristic scoring, check for malware or hardcoded secrets, and install into Hermes, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or OpenCode agent directories.

name: Omni Inference
summary: The core OpenAI-compatible inference endpoints: chat completions, embeddings, images, audio (TTS/STT), moderations, rerank, and the Responses API. The primary integration surface for AI agents.

name: Omni Mcp
summary: Connect to the OmniRoute MCP server (110 tools, 3 transports: SSE/stdio/HTTP). Covers routing, cache, compression, memory, skills, providers, and audit tools across 33 permission scopes.

name: Omni Models
summary: Query available AI models across all configured providers. List models, resolve model aliases, and browse the full model catalog including provider-specific variants.

name: Omni Providers
summary: Manage provider connections, API keys, OAuth flows, and connection tests via the REST API. List, add, update, remove, and test AI provider integrations across OmniRoute's 327-provider catalog.

name: Omni Proxies
summary: Configure HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS proxies for upstream provider requests. Set per-provider or global proxy rules, test connectivity, and manage proxy rotation.

name: Omni Resilience
summary: Monitor provider health, circuit-breaker states, p50/p95/p99 latency metrics, and budget guard alerts. Inspect connection cooldowns and model lockouts in real time.

name: Omni Settings
summary: Read and update global application settings: system prompts, thinking budget, IP filters, payload rules, combo defaults, and require-login configuration.

name: Omni Sync Cloud
summary: Synchronise OmniRoute configuration, provider connections, and settings to/from cloud storage. Manage cloud worker authentication and remote backup targets.

name: Omni Tunnels
summary: Create and manage secure tunnels (ngrok, Cloudflare Tunnel, custom) to expose OmniRoute to the internet or share access with remote agents and CI pipelines.

name: Omni Usage Logs
summary: Access detailed call logs and usage analytics. Filter by provider, model, time range, status, and cost. Export logs and aggregate token usage across all connections.

name: Omni Version Manager
summary: Install, start, stop, restart, and update embedded services (9Router, CLIProxyAPI). Monitor service status, retrieve logs, and configure auto-start for local-only service endpoints.

name: Omni Webhooks
summary: Register, list, test, and remove webhook endpoints. Configure event subscriptions (request.completed, request.failed, quota.exceeded, etc.) and manage delivery retries.

name: Ponytail
summary: External agent skill (MIT, github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail). Forces the laziest solution that actually works: question whether the task needs to exist at all (YAGNI), reuse what is already in the codebase, reach for the standard library before custom code, native platform features before dependencies, one line before fifty. Climb the ladder on every coding task — writing, adding, refactoring, fixing, reviewing, or designing code, and choosing libraries or dependencies. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra. Never cut validation, error handling, security, or accessibility.
